entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The applicant who is in custody since 21.09.2022 has approache Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Patamda P.S. Case No.42/2022.

The applicant has been made accused for the offence under Sections 419/ 420/ 337 and 338 of IPC,
Section 3 of the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, Section 13 of the Drug (control) Act, Section 15(2)(3) of the Indian Medical Council Act and Section 41(1) (2) and (11) of the Clinical Establishment (Registration and Regulations) Act.
The applicant is an accused of doing medical practice and he is neither authorized nor competent for the same.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that he has been falsely implicated in this case.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.

Learned Spl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant and submitted that investigation clearly suggest that this applicant was doing the unfair medical practice and as such he is not entitled for bail.
Considering the materials available on record, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at Indranil Chowdhary @ Indranil ... vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
